name: Atomstack A5 Pro 10W
tagline: 10W Ultra-budget diode laser — minimum viable entry point
tldr: Atomstack A5 Pro 10W is the 10W SKU on the Atomstack atomstack a5 pro line. One of the cheapest ways to try laser engraving. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.

priceRange.note: 10W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Lowest cost entry to laser engraving
Large work area for the price
cons: Build quality and alignment vary unit to unit
40W label is marketing — real output is much lower
May need significant tinkering out of the box
Resale value low if you upgrade quickly
beginnerNotes: Choose 10W if it matches your typical jobs. Compare cut depth and price against other tiers in this product line before ordering.
proTips: Square the frame before first use. Replace the stock board if you hit firmware limits. Do not trust '40W' for business planning — test cut depth yourself on your unit.
primaryUse: Lowest-cost experimentation with diode laser engraving on small wood and leather projects.
mainObjective: Hobby engraving on wood, leather, and coated metal with light to moderate cutting
